hypotheses.B0_pca_rank64_remains_compact: At natural endpoint rank 64, four frozen groups retain at least 0.85 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.B1_random_rank32_remains_compact: On random rank-32 endpoint charts, four frozen groups retain at least 0.85 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.B2_random_rank64_remains_compact: On random rank-64 endpoint charts, four frozen groups retain at least 0.85 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.B3_every_chart_is_low_order: Five or fewer groups reach 90% fidelity for every basis, rank, and corpus.
hypotheses.B4_group_order_is_chart_stable: Every non-reference chart shares at least three of the reference PCA-32 top-four groups.
hypotheses.B5_natural_chart_is_privileged: At matched rank, natural PCA top-four fidelity exceeds random-chart fidelity by at least 0.03 on every corpus.
hypotheses.B6_endpoint_rank_is_stable: PCA rank-64 top-four fidelity stays within 0.03 of PCA rank-32 on every corpus.
